title: Nested Container Clean Agency
concept: Kessa Ridge Volcano Observatory: a warm off-white editorial shell with rails and corner squares that houses dark rounded blocks — a topographic hero with a live seismogram card, an instrument network, field-night and research-feed plans, a plain-words bulletin log and a 24 h duty-line CTA.
notes: No dependencies beyond Google Fonts (Inter Tight + JetBrains Mono). Contours are generated at build time; the seismogram is a 2D canvas paused offscreen/hidden and drawn as a still frame under reduced motion.
